snippets.title: Cornerstone Advisors Appoints Steve Williams as CEO
snippets.snippet: Cornerstone Advisors Appoints Steve Williams as CEO ... # Cornerstone Advisors Appoints Steve Williams as CEO ... May 17, 2024 ... Williams succeeds Scott Sommer, who will assume the role of board chairman and drive the company’s M&A strategy. ... Scottsdale, Ariz., May 17, 2024 – Cornerstone Advisors, a leading management and technology consultancy for banks, credit unions, and fintech firms, announced today that Steve Williams, the company’s long-standing president, has been appointed chief executive officer. Williams succeeds Scott Sommer, who co-founded Cornerstone with Williams and others in 2002 and will now serve as Cornerstone’s chairman of the board.
